name: evidence-lane-plugin
description: Evidence Lane turns fragmented long-running Codex work into one evidence-backed, resumable project without taking the user's decisions away.

interface.shortDescription: Turn long Codex work into evidence-backed, resumable, human-governed projects.
interface.longDescription: Serious Codex projects rarely fail because the model cannot write code. They fail because the project fragments: source, dirty work, plans, research, databases, installed runtimes, deployments, and human decisions drift into separate realities. Evidence Lane reconnects those realities without collapsing them. It keeps source, worktree, Project Truth, Plan, ChatLineage, Project Memory, Canon, Agent Learning, installed runtime, candidates, and accepted PVs as separate authorities; retrieves only the bounded evidence needed by the active Delta; and carries unfinished work across tasks through governed State Travel. Every change stays traceable to its source and active Plan row. Tests, commits, deployments, and polished responses remain evidence, not approval. Project and Learning HIL decisions stay with the user. The 3.0.0 Codex package routes 91 native actions and 26 governed skills through ENV/UOP and the internal SDK. Its 18 project-sector lanes remain distinct, while 11 lifecycle event classes and 44 ordered handlers connect host signals to the governed workflow. Inspectable SQLite/FTS, Mermaid/DOT maps, conditional CPU/NVIDIA/AMD execution, exact Git/CI delivery, and receipts make refresh, rollback, installation, and continuity reviewable.
defaultPrompt: Open my Evidence Lane project, verify readiness, show safe entrypoints, and route through the installed SDK.
Show the accepted project state, current Plan row, recent changes, and supporting evidence without changing anything.
Explain the current governed HIL, the exact next human decision, and what each choice would change.
